title.en: BRUNEI NATIONAL PETROLEUM COMPANY SENDIRIAN BERHAD AMENDMENT NO.2 ORDER 2003

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-12-2003-BRUNEI-NATIONAL-PETROLEUM-COMPANY-SENDIRIAN-BERHAD-AMENDMENT-NO.2-ORDER-2003.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 1 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
The Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad Order, 2002 is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 12 - "Audit. 12A. The accounts of the Company shall be audited annually by - {a) the Auditor General; or {b) any person who has been authorised to perform the duties required by the Companies Act (Chapter 39) to be performed by an auditor, who shall be appointed annually by the Company: Provided that where the accounts of the Company have been audited by a person appointed under paragraph {b), they may be verified by the Auditor General.". Made this 21st. day of Muharam, 1424 Hijriah corresponding to the 24th. day of March, 2003 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
